lines.say: In your city, every green light goes to the highest bidder.
You bid three dollars a light to get home on time. It works.
Then a siren behind you. An ambulance. Bidding one dollar.
You raise to five. You get the green. You are home in ten minutes.
Then your phone rings. The hospital. The ambulance was carrying your mom.
Would you have outbid the ambulance? Write it in the comments.
